name: Grounding-anything Dataset (GranD)
description: GranD is a large-scale dataset for the novel task of visually Grounded Conversation Generation (GCG), providing dense pixel-wise object grounding with 7.5M unique concepts and 810M regions annotated with segmentation masks. It supports evaluation of models generating natural language responses intertwined with object segmentation masks.
reputation: A large, recent multimodal grounding dataset that has attracted interest for grounded conversation and segmentation research, but is still emerging rather than broadly standardized.
notes: First dataset for visually grounded conversation generation with dense pixel-wise grounding and segmentation masks.
